# k3d_istio (Resource)

Istio installed from its official Helm charts: `base`, then `istiod`, then an optional `gateway`, all at one pinned `version`. Create the namespace first, for example with `k3d_namespace`, and make workloads that use sidecar injection depend on this resource. With a gateway, do not label the namespace `istio-injection: disabled`: the gateway gets its proxy image through injection, so its pod never starts. A component that is removed or changed outside Terraform is restored by the next apply. Destroying this resource leaves Istio's CRDs in the cluster, as the chart intends, and reinstalling reuses them. An install made with `istioctl` has no Helm releases, so it cannot be imported: set `take_ownership` to adopt its objects with a new install. Import a Helm install with `<cluster>/<namespace>`. If Traefik is enabled on the cluster, a `LoadBalancer` gateway conflicts with it on ports 80 and 443.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "k3d_namespace" "mesh" {
  cluster = k3d_cluster.main.id
  name    = "istio-system"
}

resource "k3d_istio" "mesh" {
  cluster   = k3d_cluster.main.id
  namespace = k3d_namespace.mesh.name
  version   = "1.30.1"

  gateway = {
    http_node_port  = 31035
    https_node_port = 30903
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version` (String) Istio version, such as `1.30.1`. Changing it upgrades every component in order.

### Optional

- `base_values` (List of String) YAML documents for the `base` chart, merged in order.
- `cluster` (String) Cluster to manage the object in, usually `k3d_cluster.<name>.id`, so the object is recreated when the cluster is replaced. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `gateway` (Attributes) An ingress gateway. Left out, no gateway is installed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateway))
- `istiod_values` (List of String) YAML documents for the `istiod` chart, merged in order, such as `meshConfig` or `pilot.resources`.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster that is reached directly and not through Docker. Not recorded as a dependency on the cluster's lifetime, so prefer `cluster` for clusters in the same configuration. It is stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.
- `namespace` (String) Existing namespace for every component. Defaults to `istio-system`.
- `repository` (String) Chart repository, for use with a mirror. Defaults to Istio's official repository.
- `take_ownership` (Boolean) Let the install adopt existing objects, such as ones from `istioctl`. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeout` (String) How long each component can take. Defaults to `10m`.

### Read-Only

- `base_revision` (Number) Current revision of the `base` release.
- `gateway_revision` (Number) Current revision of the `gateway` release, null without a gateway.
- `id` (String) `<cluster>/<namespace>`.
- `istiod_revision` (Number) Current revision of the `istiod` release.
- `status` (String) `deployed` when every component is, otherwise the status of the first one that is not.

<a id="nestedatt--gateway"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateway`

Optional:

- `http_node_port` (Number) Fixed NodePort for port 80, so that `k3d_cluster.ports` can target it.
- `https_node_port` (Number) Fixed NodePort for port 443.
- `name` (String) Release name, which also sets the pod labels. The default `istio-ingressgateway` gives `istio: ingressgateway`, which a `Gateway` object selects.
- `service_type` (String) Service type. Defaults to `NodePort`, which pairs with `k3d_cluster.ports`.
- `values` (List of String) YAML documents for the `gateway` chart, merged after the settings above.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import k3d_istio.mesh demo/istio-system
```
